name: unihub-insight
description: Desktop retail intelligence for the UniHub ecosystem.

scripts.dev:e2e: npm run build && UNIHUB_INSIGHT_API_COMMAND='npm run dev:api:e2e' UNIHUB_INSIGHT_WEB_COMMAND='npm run preview:web' bash scripts/dev.sh
scripts.lint: npm --workspace @unihub-insight/web run lint && uv run --project apps/api ruff check apps/api/src apps/api/tests
scripts.format: npm --workspace @unihub-insight/web run format && uv run --project apps/api ruff format apps/api/src apps/api/tests
scripts.format:check: npm --workspace @unihub-insight/web run format:check && uv run --project apps/api ruff format --check apps/api/src apps/api/tests
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace @unihub-insight/web run typecheck && uv run --project apps/api mypy --config-file apps/api/pyproject.toml apps/api/src
scripts.test: npm --workspace @unihub-insight/web run test && uv run --project apps/api pytest apps/api/tests
